title: Cookie policy
description: Which cookies and local storage josecoded.com uses: cookieless statistics, session, referral cookie and the anti-robot check.

sections.heading: In short
paragraphs: The site shows no cookie banner because it uses no cookies that need your consent, except the referral one, which is only stored if you accept it.

sections.heading: What the site uses
items: Statistics (Umami, on my own server): no cookies and no personal identifiers; only aggregate visit counts.
Session (necessary technical cookies): only if you sign in; they keep your session open and are deleted when you sign out or they expire.

«ref» cookie (30 days): stores the code of whoever recommended you, only after you accept it explicitly. If you do not accept, the code is kept in the browser's session storage and disappears when it closes.
Browser session storage (not a cookie): remembers what kind of visitor you are («audience») to adapt contact and the area. It is deleted when you close the tab.
Anti-robot check (Cloudflare Turnstile): may use its own security technologies when you submit a form.
Call booking (Cal.com): only loaded if you press «Book»; from then on Cal.com's cookies and policy apply.

sections.heading: How to manage them
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking the technical ones may prevent signing in.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If the site starts using other cookies this policy will be updated and, if needed, your consent requested. The Spanish version is the legally binding one.
